name: Paneer Tikka Taco
menu_role: TACOS — 2 small tacos per order (Core 5; vegetarian signature)
cooking_method: Marinate in hung curd 1-4 h, char over very high direct heat to order (tandoor unresolved; charbroiler/comal/oven+broiler as a labelled substitute)

portion.construction: two small folded tacos, salsa on the side

lines.prep: about 2 cm cubes, cold, patted dry
in the marinade (mustard oil is EXCLUDED from the baseline)

steps: Hang yogurt 2-4 h (about 50% weight) in the cold; make marinade (hung curd, ginger-garlic, chilli, turmeric, kasuri methi, chaat masala, salt, lemon, oil).
Marinate paneer cubes 1-4 h at ≤ 5 °C (not past 8 h; the marinade waters and the texture softens).
Skewer or place cubes on a very hot surface; char 2-4 min total, turning, until visible char with a soft interior (heat source decided in Session 2).
Warm tortillas on a dry comal; fill with 3 cubes each, salsa, raw onion, cilantro, pickled onion; serve at once with lime.

critical_parameters.paneer_core_C: hold at 60 °C or above after cooking (Session 2 rule); discard cooked or marinated paneer left out of temperature control for 2 h or more
critical_parameters.heat_source: UNRESOLVED (tandoor vs charbroiler vs comal+broiler); a substitute is labelled, not called a tandoor

plating: Two small tacos on a plate cross-section visible, 2-3 charred paneer cubes showing, salsa verde in a small cup at the side, lime wedge. No melted cheese.
equipment: Tandoor (UNRESOLVED) or charbroiler/high-heat grill; hood and fire-suppression answer is a [PRO] question
Cloth/sieve for hanging yogurt, cold storage ≤ 5 °C
food_safety: Marinate at or below 5 °C; discard marinated or cooked paneer held 2 h or more outside temperature control.
Paneer is a TCS dairy food: keep cold, hot-hold at or above 57 °C after cooking.
Separate raw-onion and salsa handling; wash produce.
Check rennet/acid source for vegetarian labelling; mustard only if mustard oil/blends are ever introduced (excluded from the baseline).

day_before: Hang yogurt (4 h), marinade batch, cut and marinate paneer (≤ 8 h)
morning: Skewer cubes, prepare tortillas warm station
service: Char to order (2-4 min), warm tortillas, assemble

pairing.risk: Banana esters against char and chaat masala.

must_show: visible char marks on the paneer cubes, orange-red tikka marinade colour
corn tortillas with natural spots, folded not rolled
bright green salsa, white raw onion, cilantro, pink pickled onion, lime wedge
